card.name: Instruction words in dosing directions
card.fires_on: Short instruction words in dosing and administration directions, such as 'before' after a time span, 'rotate' injection sites, 'thumb' in injection steps, or 'such' before a list of drugs. Also the middle of the drug name diclofenac.
